title: Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution: Tracing Training Influence to Learned Behavioral Policies
abstract: arXiv:2606.29171v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While existing data attribution methods can identify which training examples build specific mechanistic circuits, they cannot explain how training data shapes the behavioral decisions a model learns. We introduce Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution (SMDA), a framework that attributes training pairs to the interpretable symbolic policies governing model behavior. SMDA fits a closed-form Ridge regression over sparse autoencoder (SAE) features to model a behavior, then decomposes how each supervised fine-tuning (SFT) example shifts that policy through feature-activation ($\Delta X$) and output-probability ($\Delta Y$) pathways. We distill a symbolic policy for refusal in Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and analyze 200 SFT pairs. Our analysis reveals (1)~the symbolic policy's coefficients expose systematic gaps in the base model's safety behavior, such as religious stereotyping; (2)~per-feature $\Delta X/\Delta Y$ decomposition mechanistic

translated_title: 符号机制数据归因：追踪训练影响至习得的行为策略
translated_abstract: 虽然现有的数据归因方法能够识别哪些训练样本构建了特定的机制电路，但它们无法解释训练数据如何塑造模型习得的行为决策。我们提出了符号机制数据归因（Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution, SMDA），这是一个将训练数据对归因到控制模型行为的可解释符号策略的框架。SMDA 在稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征上拟合闭式岭回归来对某一行为建模，然后分解每个监督微调（SFT）样本如何通过特征激活（ΔX）和输出概率（ΔY）两条通路改变该策略。我们在 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 中提炼了拒绝行为的符号策略，并分析了 200 个 SFT 数据对。我们的分析揭示：(1) 符号策略的系数暴露了基础模型安全行为中的系统性缺陷，例如宗教刻板印象；(2) 逐特征的 ΔX/ΔY 分解能够机制性地……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出符号机制数据归因（SMDA）框架，通过在稀疏自编码器特征上拟合可解释的符号策略，并将每个微调样本的影响分解为特征激活（ΔX）与输出概率（ΔY）两条通路，从而将训练数据归因到模型习得的行为策略，并借此揭示基础模型安全行为中的系统性缺陷（如宗教刻板印象）。
en_tdlr: SMDA attributes training pairs to interpretable symbolic policies governing model behavior by fitting a Ridge regression over SAE features and decomposing each SFT example's influence into feature-activation (ΔX) and output-probability (ΔY) pathways, exposing systematic gaps such as religious stereotyping in the base model's safety behavior.
